experiment.reference: 0 to 2 distinct candidate ids, disjoint from covariates; the candidate arm uses covariates plus reference, the reference arm uses reference only
experiment.window_rule: the last window_days revealed days are scored; each scored day is forecast at the end of the previous day from the 7 preceding days

result_fields: 95% interval (moving-block bootstrap, blocks of min(2, window_days // 7) days: 1, 2 or 2; indicative below 14 days)

researcher.model_rule: sha256 of the model id; it is the id requested and served at engine-ledger seqs 74 and 76 (the identifier itself is not written in the repository). The research job refuses to start unless sha256(vars.RESEARCHER_MODEL) equals it, and every response's served model must hash to it

scripted_strategy.final_selection: every candidate whose latest single-candidate result has a 95% lower bound above 0
